faqs.question: Is 😐❓ passive-aggressive?
faqs.answer: 😐❓ can be passive-aggressive when the sarcasm cue is masking a real complaint. Watch the lead-up; if the sender was annoyed before, the combo is doing sarcasm work on top of frustration.

faqs.question: What does 😐❓ mean?
faqs.answer: 😐❓ is a sarcasm-coded combo. The two emojis pair to make the read unmistakably ironic — the sender is signaling that whatever they said is meant to be taken sideways.

faqs.question: Should I send 😐❓ to my boss?
faqs.answer: Do not lead with 😐❓ to a boss unless you have a tight rapport. Sarcasm-coded emojis are easy to misread upward.

faqs.question: Is 😐❓ an insult?
faqs.answer: 😐❓ is not a direct insult. The sarcasm-coded cue is a soft tease; if it lands as an insult, the sender usually wrote the lead-up that way.
